acceptance.command: env ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD=1 pnpm install --silent >/dev/null 2>&1 && cd packages/runtime && npx vitest run src/services/session/completion-backflow.test.ts -t 'U6_SETTLED_CHAIN'

acceptance.title: 无 parentAgentSessionId 的完成不回流
acceptance.command: env ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD=1 pnpm install --silent >/dev/null 2>&1 && cd packages/runtime && npx vitest run src/services/session/completion-backflow.test.ts -t 'U6_NO_PARENT_SKIP'
acceptance.scenario: spawnSource==='agent' 但无 parentAgentSessionId（spawnSource 可单独成立）→ 跳过回流；spawnSource!=='agent'（用户 session）→ 跳过

acceptance.title: 子 session 进程 exit 失败回流
